locations.label: Armory power switch
locations.description: Open the courtyard route to the power switch in the Armory near Stamin-Up. In the Undercroft, stand on each of the four plates around the pyramid until it lights. After all four are active, low gravity cycles on and off, allowing wall-running. Activate Wundersphere landing pads when passing them so the launchers can be used later. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Pyramid gravity plates
locations.description: Open the courtyard route to the power switch in the Armory near Stamin-Up. In the Undercroft, stand on each of the four plates around the pyramid until it lights. After all four are active, low gravity cycles on and off, allowing wall-running. Activate Wundersphere landing pads when passing them so the launchers can be used later. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Possible Pack-a-Punch: Undercroft
locations.description: Teleport two Pack-a-Punch components by interacting with them; the machine assembles at the third location. Check the Death Ray platform, Undercroft and Rocket Pad. The indicator signs track its current location after it moves. Feed the three stone dragons at the lower courtyard, Church and Undercroft with nearby zombie kills, one at a time; wait until each finishes eating before the next kill. When all three crumble, collect Wrath of the Ancients behind the Knight’s Tomb. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
